headline: Hi I’m Zack Jones - Security Sales Engineer & Offensive Security Specialist
tagline: 15+ years in offensive security: penetration testing, vulnerability assessments, and exploitation, with a couple years in incident response, and lately a Senior Sales Engineer.

experience.title: Senior Sales Engineer & Team Lead - Rapid7
bullets: Partner with account executives and commercial customers across the pre-sales cycle, uncovering security and technical requirements and consulting on Rapid7 solutions mapped to each stakeholder's environment and use cases.
Own technical evaluations end to end, scoping and running hands-on Proof of Concept engagements that prove solution fit against customer requirements and drive the technical win.
Collaborate with customers during onboarding to build out their Rapid7 instances, co-developing workflows and reports that get their teams to value faster.
Mentor and enable fellow sales engineers as team lead, developing playbooks and training that raise technical consistency and ramp new hires faster.
Contribute to the security community through hands-on enablement, producing demo videos and webinars and delivering live product demonstrations at industry events including Black Hat.

experience.title: Lead Penetration Tester -  Airiam
bullets: Delivered vulnerability & risk assessments, internal/external penetration tests, and OSINT/operational assessments.
Built workflows, tooling, documentation, and reporting for engagements; mentored junior testers on enumeration and recon.
Helped design the pen-test team's roles, policies, training, and certification program for new offerings.
Uncovered a previously-exploited, unnoticed vulnerability in a client's production web application.

experience.title: Incident Response Specialist - MePush
bullets: Responded to active threats and ransomware, coordinating on-site and remote teams through mitigation and recovery.
Ran forensic investigations and worked alongside government agencies and cyber insurance to identify threats.
Rebuilt infrastructure (servers, segmentation, Active Directory GPOs) and closed the initial access vector.
Handled a ransomware incident as a two-person team - 2k machines, 20 servers, minimal docs - resolved in 10 days.
Built fast-turnaround scripts (decryption, AD domain-join troubleshooting, forensic collection) used across IR teams.

experience.title: Computer Science Adjunct Instructor - Danville Community College
bullets: Created curriculum and taught Intro to Game Design (Unreal Engine 4) and SDLC application development.
Ran a realistic game-design-studio scenario for 2D animation and menu work, plus freelance-readiness coaching.

experience.title: Computer Science Instructor - Hargrave Military Academy
bullets: Created curriculum and taught Intro to Computer Science and Intro to Cyber Security to classes of 7 - 12 cadets.
Built engaging, CTF-driven classes ([learnctf.com](http://learnctf.com), Hack The Box), customized to each cadet's interests.
Taught physical computing / IoT with Arduino and Processing, building network-connected devices via APIs.

experience.title: Network Tech / Installer - River City Systems
bullets: Installed network infrastructure in schools and businesses: line termination, connection/length testing, IP-camera prep.
Collaborated on VLANs, segmentation, and VMS design for a large public-school IP-camera deployment.

bullets: *Not listed above: contractual penetration testing and security assessments for various vendors, MSSPs, and clients. Engagements under NDA.*
